summary: An unreadable source and a read-only destination both fail as permission_denied with no effect, so they remain eligible for an elevated retry
note: Skipped, not failed, when the process can read mode-000 files (root), since permission failures cannot be produced there.

macos.note: The retry policy is identical. The macOS retry goes through a privileged helper (SMAppService daemon over XPC) instead of pkexec; the helper needs a signed build and user approval, so it is not exercised by the scenarios.
